title: Skeptical Finnish ROV team calls it man-made and like a power line

tellings.quote: This must be man-made. This is constructed."

plain: In 2019, a doubtful Finnish team sent a remote-controlled underwater robot down to a strange object found on the floor of the Baltic Sea. According to the treasure hunter Dennis Asberg, who found the object, their operator said, "This must be man-made. This is constructed," and likened it to a power line. Asberg tells the story to show that even doubters saw it as something built rather than natural rock.
